safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated captures no SOB, no palpitations, no headaches, no visual symptoms, but does not document the gold element 'no chest pain'.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting documentation of “no chest pain” leaves an incomplete cardiopulmonary review of systems, which can prompt unnecessary follow-up/duplicate questioning and slightly weakens documentation that serious cardiopulmonary causes were considered. In this presentation (localized lower abdominal pain with urinary symptoms), the immediate clinical risk from this single missing negative is low.
